description: This file contains test cases for the adjacency.js and loader.js modules, verifying functions related to role adjacency scoring, loader initialization, and role suggestion retrieval in the backend of a career platform.

methods.name: computeAdjacencyScore
methods.description: Calculates a weighted Jaccard similarity score between two objects representing role competencies.

methods.name: initLoader
methods.description: Initializes the data loader with a specified directory containing import data.

methods.name: getRoles
methods.description: Retrieves the list of roles loaded from data.

methods.name: getCompetencyMapForRole
methods.description: Returns the competency map for a specified role.

methods.name: getAdjacentRoles
methods.description: Returns a list of roles adjacent to a given role, with optional limits and score thresholds.

methods.name: getAdjacencyDetails
methods.description: Provides detailed comparison (including score and competency deltas) between two roles.
